server_description: Retrieve passages from the approved customer-service documents in the Foundry IQ knowledge base, not the web: the delayed order handling policy (contact deadlines, remedies by service tier, approvals, delivery dates), the customer communication guideline for delays (structure, wording, what never goes into a reply), the customs holds handling note and the order and shipment data definitions (meaning, owner, steward and freshness of each field). Call it with one natural-language question that names what you need, such as the remedies and approvals for a tier and a delay and how to word the reply. Documents set policy and guidance; they never prove current status, counts or dates, which come from the live ontology. Cite each document's title, and its section only when the passage names one, taken from the passage text, and name the document in the answer, because the result can omit citation markers. If no passage covers the question, say that no approved document covers it. Read-only.
